steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Unlock Early Access Buy a Decimated Avatar NFT on Magic Eden to gain Early Access to the game.
2 Step 2 : Get Your Game Key Join the official Decimated Discord server and receive a serial key to download the game on Steam . Stay alert for potential scammers!
3 Step 3 : Play and Earn Jump into the game, complete missions, and rise on the leaderboards to earn $DIO tokens.
4 Step 4 : Boost Earnings Earn additional $DIO tokens by completing tasks on Zealy and staking your DIO tokens .
